# How to use this scaffold

Replace the guide text with your own evidence and interpretation. Keep the
report within 2000 words, excluding references and optional supporting
artefacts.

```{r setup}
find_repo_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
  current <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  while (TRUE) {
    candidate_bootstrap <- file.path(current, "bootstrap.R")
    candidate_desc <- file.path(current, "DESCRIPTION")
    if (file.exists(candidate_bootstrap) && file.exists(candidate_desc)) {
      return(current)
    }

    parent <- dirname(current)
    if (identical(parent, current)) {
      stop(
        "Unable to find rPVA repo root from this working directory. ",
        "Run Quarto from a directory that includes DESCRIPTION and bootstrap.R, ",
        "or use setwd() to switch to the repo root before rendering."
      )
    }
    current <- parent
  }
}
repo_root <- find_repo_root()

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = repo_root)
bootstrap_path <- file.path(repo_root, "bootstrap.R")
source(bootstrap_path, chdir = TRUE)
```

```{r woodhen-evidence}
decision_lens <- Sys.getenv("RPVA_DECISION_LENS", "choose_one_decision_lens")
selected_scenario_id <- Sys.getenv("RPVA_SELECTED_SCENARIO_ID", "choose_one_core_scenario")
chosen_sensitivity_id <- Sys.getenv("RPVA_CHOSEN_SENSITIVITY_ID", "choose_one_sensitivity")
sensitivity_reason <- Sys.getenv("RPVA_SENSITIVITY_REASON", "write_your_biological_reason")
expected_direction <- Sys.getenv("RPVA_EXPECTED_DIRECTION", "write_expected_direction_before_reading_result")
advice_change_condition <- Sys.getenv("RPVA_ADVICE_CHANGE_CONDITION", "write_condition_that_would_change_your_advice")

assert_student_choices <- function(decision_lens,
                                   selected_scenario_id,
                                   chosen_sensitivity_id,
                                   sensitivity_reason,
                                   expected_direction,
                                   advice_change_condition) {
  values <- c(
    decision_lens = decision_lens,
    selected_scenario_id = selected_scenario_id,
    chosen_sensitivity_id = chosen_sensitivity_id,
    sensitivity_reason = sensitivity_reason,
    expected_direction = expected_direction,
    advice_change_condition = advice_change_condition
  )
  unfinished <- names(values)[
    !nzchar(trimws(values)) |
      grepl("^(choose_one_|write_)", values)
  ]
  if (length(unfinished)) {
    stop(
      "Complete the student choice fields before rendering: ",
      paste(unfinished, collapse = ", "),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  catalog <- woodhen_management_catalog()
  selected <- catalog[catalog$scenario_id == selected_scenario_id, , drop = FALSE]
  if (!nrow(selected) || selected$section[[1]] != "core_management") {
    stop("selected_scenario_id must be an approved core Woodhen scenario ID.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  chosen <- catalog[catalog$scenario_id == chosen_sensitivity_id, , drop = FALSE]
  if (!nrow(chosen) || chosen$section[[1]] != "sensitivity" || chosen_sensitivity_id == "sensitivity_default") {
    stop("chosen_sensitivity_id must be an approved non-baseline sensitivity ID.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  invisible(TRUE)
}

assert_student_choices(
  decision_lens,
  selected_scenario_id,
  chosen_sensitivity_id,
  sensitivity_reason,
  expected_direction,
  advice_change_condition
)

core_runs <- run_woodhen_management_set(
  c("01_no_mgmt", "02_pig_control", "03_captive_pig", "04_rodent_eradication", "05_future_baseline"),
  keep_traj = FALSE,
  seed = 123
)

selected_run <- run_woodhen_management_scenario(selected_scenario_id, keep_traj = TRUE, seed = 123)

chosen_sensitivity <- run_woodhen_management_set(
  c("sensitivity_default", chosen_sensitivity_id),
  keep_traj = FALSE,
  seed = 123
)
```
